name: Common Peroneal Neuropathy / Fibular Neuropathy
definition: Neuropathy of the common fibular/peroneal nerve, often near the fibular neck, causing dorsiflexion/eversion weakness and sensory disturbance.

typical: Sensory change over dorsum of foot/lateral leg

core: Dorsiflexion, toe extension and eversion strength
Inversion to help distinguish L5 root disease

investigations.principle: Electrodiagnostic studies help localize and grade lesions.
investigations.MRI: MRI/ultrasound may identify mass, trauma or focal structural cause.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs when fibular/knee trauma is suspected.

amber: Surgical decompression or repair depends on lesion severity, cause and recovery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Peripheral Vata/neurological phenotype may be documented in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Neuropathy of the common fibular/peroneal nerve, often near the fibular neck, causing dorsiflexion/eversion weakness and sensory disturbance.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
